requirements.rule: RENEWAL 2027-2029 (ipotesi of 15 September 2026, Allegati B-E pp. 20-22; the parties report the definitive signature of 23 October 2026, whose text is not public): the retribuzione base mensile from 1 October 2026, 1 July 2027, 1 July 2028 and 1 July 2029 is modelled; level 6 is abolished and paid as level 5 from 1 October 2026 (art. 10). Not modelled: the una tantum of Allegato D (two instalments with the January and July 2027 pay, 290.00 to 190.00 EUR per instalment by level), and the seniority of a former level 6 worker, kept at the level 6 amounts already matured.
requirements.remediation: Check the definitive text of 23 October 2026, model the una tantum of Allegato D as una tantum items, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: INPS RATES. Terziario proxy used. ASSOFARM entities operate as aziende speciali or società di gestione farmacia (private-law entities under municipal control); the contract is registered CNEL H124 and negotiated by UGL Terziario — standard private-sector INPS regime (terziario) is the expected classification. Note: CCNL text references "INPS Gestione ex INPDAP" in benefit provisions, suggesting legacy workers transferred from public-sector management may retain the ex-INPDAP pension regime — contribution rates for those workers differ. No sector-specific INPS circular identified; kitech.it does not list a dedicated contribution table for farmacie municipalizzate. Simplification retained.
requirements.remediation: Verify the INPS classification against a sector circular, including ex-INPDAP legacy workers.
